filters: UTC days with >= 20 usable samples count as events
current residual: observed minus predicted, nearest sample within 6 min
applicability: Wind at CO-OPS 8638614 and current at cb0402 bin 4, 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, wind >= 5 kt.
limitations: Observations only: forecast error and tide error are not fitted.
Direction scatter is within-hour variability, not forecast direction error.
No storm or hurricane winds in the data window.
Gust factor is truncated at gust >= sustained and fitted for wind >= 5 kt.
qualification_reasons: Only 364 days of data; the policy needs at least 365.
Hurricane and storm-force winds are outside the data and the model; forecast error is not modeled.
